description: Java Spring MVC Controller class for managing content images in an admin web interface. Handles viewing, adding, deleting images with mappings to specific endpoints. Uses services for content management and utility classes for image path construction.

classes.name: ContentImageController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller dedicated to managing static content images within the web admin interface.

methods.name: displayFileBrowser
methods.description: Displays the file browser for JavaScript content editor; maps to /admin/content/fileBrowser.html.

methods.name: getContentImages
methods.description: Retrieves and displays images for a merchant store; maps to /admin/content/contentImages.html and contentManagement.html.

methods.name: pageImages
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of image filenames as JSON, including URLs constructed for static image access.

methods.name: displayContentImagesCreate
methods.description: Displays the page/form for uploading new content images.

methods.name: saveContentImages
methods.description: Handles POST request to upload and save new images to the content service.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Removes an image by name from the store, responding with success or failure in JSON.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set menu attributes for the view model.
